title: £1,000 at 5% compounded annually
caption: The balance reaches £1,628.89 after 10 years. It doubles to £2,000 at ln 2/ln 1.05 ≈ 14.2 years; the rule of 72 says 72/5 = 14.4 years, close but a little high.
alt: An upward-curving exponential from £1,000, with points at 10 years (£1,628.89) and where it reaches £2,000 near 14.2 years.
description: Each year multiplies the balance by 1.05, so after t years it is 1000 × 1.05^t.
At t = 10 the balance is about £1,628.89.
The balance hits £2,000 at ln 2/ln 1.05 ≈ 14.2 years; the rule of 72 estimates 14.4.
